name: WSDL Operation
description: Schema describing an operation element within a WSDL 2.0 interface. An operation defines an abstract action the web service supports, including the message exchange pattern and the input, output, and fault messages.

name.description: The local name of the operation, unique within its parent interface.

pattern.description: A URI identifying the message exchange pattern (e.g., in-out, in-only, robust-in-only).

style.description: URIs identifying the operation style, overriding the interface default.

safe.description: Indicates whether invoking this operation is semantically safe and has no side effects.

messageLabel.description: A label identifying this message within the message exchange pattern.

element.description: A qualified name referencing the element declaration for the input message content.

input.description: The input message for this operation.

messageLabel.description: A label identifying this message within the message exchange pattern.

element.description: A qualified name referencing the element declaration for the output message content.

output.description: The output message for this operation.

ref.description: A qualified name referencing an interface fault declaration.

messageLabel.description: A label identifying this fault within the message exchange pattern.

infault.description: A list of faults that may occur during the input phase of the operation.

ref.description: A qualified name referencing an interface fault declaration.

messageLabel.description: A label identifying this fault within the message exchange pattern.

outfault.description: A list of faults that may occur during the output phase of the operation.
